description: This file provides a client wrapper for interacting with Supabase's REST API within a FastAPI backend. It includes functions for constructing authentication headers (user JWT and service role), and a minimal `SupabaseRestClient` class that handles GET, POST, and PATCH requests with error handling. It centralizes environment variable management and request logic specific to Supabase, facilitating RLS-aware data access.

classes.name: SupabaseRestClient
classes.description: A minimal asynchronous client for performing REST API requests to Supabase, supporting select, insert, and update operations with RLS-aware headers.

methods.name: str _require_env(name: str)
methods.description: Fetches a required environment variable, raises RuntimeError if not found.

methods.name: str _require_anon_key()
methods.description: Retrieves the SUPABASE_ANON_KEY environment variable, with fallback to SUPABASE_KEY.

methods.name: str _supabase_url()
methods.description: Retrieves the SUPABASE_URL environment variable, ensuring proper URL formatting.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] postgrest_headers_from_user(*, access_token: str)
methods.description: Constructs headers with user JWT for RLS-aware access, including the anon key.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] postgrest_headers_service_role()
methods.description: Constructs headers with the service role key, bypassing RLS (server-side use only).
